prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1342; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Conroe, Texas, when the car behind me hit my rear bumper hard enough to jolt me forward against my seatbelt. I got out, spoke with the other driver, and gave the same description of what happened to everyone who asked, including the officer who responded and the adjuster I spoke with later. The next morning my lower back was stiff and sore, and by the afternoon the pain had spread into my hip, so I went to a clinic and was told I had a back strain. I am the household member of the policyholder and I live at the same address, so I am submitting this statement as a covered driver under that policy. I have kept every appointment and will provide any further records requested.
